primitives.name: Illustrative Example Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: Acting on the principle that example is, after all, the very best teacher, an endeavor has been made to thoroughly illustrate the various positions, plays and formations, the photographs from which the reproductions have been taken being posed with this especial end in view.
primitives.assumptions: The effectiveness of visual exemplification increases comprehension fidelity in both players and spectators.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When illustrative media fails to capture dynamic motion or context-specific nuance.

layer2.mapping: Visual exemplar space maps to cognitive state space via probabilistic belief update mechanisms in GSI; GSE uses exemplar templates for state transition prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Comprehension accuracy measured via post-reading recall and tactical interpretation consistency.

primitives.name: Spectator Comprehension Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: As the title of the work implies, the book aims also to make the game plain to the spectator who may not have enjoyed the advantage of close acquaintance afforded the man who has taken an active part in the play on the field.
primitives.assumptions: Spectators lack direct physical engagement but can infer strategic structure through structured exposition.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When descriptive language lacks sufficient formalism to bridge perceptual gap.

layer2.mapping: GSI constructs a knowledge kernel from textual and visual cues to simulate spectator understanding; GSE applies this kernel to predict spectator attention and behavioral response during live events.
layer2.telemetry: Spectator engagement metrics such as attention span and interpretation alignment with expert analysis.

primitives.name: Spirit of Play Framework
primitives.verbatim_quote: Above all, however, should a perusal of the work give the reader, be he player or spectator, an adequate idea of the spirit in which the game is both played and viewed in its best form, the author will feel adequately rewarded for his labor: F.
primitives.assumptions: The game's ethos is a latent variable influencing performance and perception quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the spirit becomes obscured by rigid rule adherence or commercialization.

layer2.mapping: The spirit of play is encoded in GSI’s normative priors; GSE encodes it into situational decision trees that reflect ethical and aesthetic values.
layer2.telemetry: Behavioral consistency with traditional play values across different contexts and levels of competition.

These transformations are modeled as stochastic mappings within a Bayesian framework, where prior beliefs about the game are updated based on new evidence. The illustrative example acts as a data-driven kernel that enhances posterior belief confidence. Spectator comprehension introduces a dual-agent model where the observer's mental state evolves according to a conditional probability distribution over possible interpretations. The spirit of play functions as a latent variable that modulates these distributions, encoding normative expectations into the system. Failure modes arise when these mappings become degenerate due to insufficient exemplification, misaligned narrative framing, or loss of cultural resonance.
